checks.cannot_catch: A pack_meta that is well formed but names the wrong id or cycle for the bytes inside.
checks.expected: pack_meta present; kind is one the device knows
checks.title: pack_meta is readable and names a known kind

checks.cannot_catch: A license tag or attribution that is present but wrong for the data.
checks.title: Attribution and license are recorded in pack_meta

checks.cannot_catch: Whether the label matches where the data really came from: the builder sets it, the check only reads it.
checks.title: Origin label is federal, community or user-supplied

checks.cannot_catch: A recorded source that is not the one the build actually used.
checks.expected: at least one source with its edition and sha256
checks.note: No upstream sources were supplied to the report (--sources).
checks.title: Upstream sources are recorded

checks.cannot_catch: Wrong values the reader accepts. It shows the device can open and query these bytes, not that what it returns is right.
checks.expected: the reader opens the pack and every query returns data
checks.note: No pyEfis checkout was available (set PYEFIS_SRC_DIR or pass --pyefis-src).
checks.title: Device acceptance: pyEfis's own reader opens the pack and answers a fixed query set

checks.cannot_catch: Wrong data in a structurally sound file.
checks.title: SQLite structure is sound (PRAGMA quick_check)

checks.cannot_catch: A table that has rows but is missing most of them.
checks.title: No data table is empty

checks.cannot_catch: A change that keeps counts steady (rows replaced by wrong rows), and any defect already present in the previous edition.
checks.expected: no table moves more than 10%; a larger move needs a build note
checks.title: Row counts against the previous edition

checks.cannot_catch: A change in the values inside an unchanged column layout.
checks.expected: no added, removed, retyped or widened column
checks.note: Needs the upstream CSVs (--inputs). The guard runs on the live download at build time.
checks.title: schema_guard layer 1: input CSV structure matches the committed snapshot

checks.cannot_catch: A column that is present but filled with wrong or blank values.
checks.note: Needs the upstream CSVs (--inputs). The guard runs on the live download at build time.
checks.title: schema_guard layer 2: every column the builder reads is present

checks.cannot_catch: A known value used with a new meaning, and every column the contract does not police.
checks.expected: no unknown value in a policed column
checks.note: Needs the upstream CSVs (--inputs). The guard runs on the live download at build time.
checks.title: schema_guard layer 3: policed columns hold only known values

checks.cannot_catch: A loss smaller than half an observed build, and a table with enough rows that are wrong.
checks.expected: every floored table at or above its floor (half an observed build)
checks.title: schema_guard layer 4: output tables clear their row floors

checks.cannot_catch: A plausible coordinate in the wrong place, such as a transposed digit that still lands on land.
checks.title: Coordinates are valid and not at 0,0

checks.cannot_catch: Two different things given the same correct-looking identifier in different tables, and a wrong identifier that happens to be unique.
checks.title: Identifiers that must be unique are unique

checks.cannot_catch: A point moved to the wrong place inside the envelope; the envelope is a handful of boxes, not a coastline.
checks.expected: no growth beyond 25 points or 10%, whichever is larger. FAA files carry real oceanic and foreign points, so the count is tracked, not forbidden
checks.title: Points outside the US coverage envelope, against the previous edition

checks.cannot_catch: Whether any one reuse is legitimate; the check only counts them.
checks.expected: no more reused navaid idents or airway sequence numbers than the previous edition
checks.measured: navaids(id, type) 33; awy_segments(awy_id, seq) 332 (previous navaids(id, type) 33; awy_segments(awy_id, seq) 332)
checks.title: Identifiers the FAA reuses, against the previous edition
